sections.text: Connect the circuit as shown in figure

This relay is induction disk type so it will not work if we inject at one 
 phase so we must inject at 2 or 3 phases as shown in figure and since the 
 function of the relay doesnt depend on direction of current so if we changed 
 5&6 point for example the result is the same.

items:
Connect the manta current terminals at phase 6&2 
 AND short points 5&3
Start increasing current from zero until pick up

Repeat the previous for the other phases as 
 follow:

Connect the manta current terminals at phase 8&2 
 AND short points 9&3

Connect the manta current terminals at phase 8&5 
 AND short points 9&6

 Procedure
Introduction
The type CHC12 relay is designed for use as a current fault detector in 
 connection with distance relays to prevent operation of the associated timer, 
 or tripping of the circuit breakers
The first draft is initiated and tested by eng. Saber Mohamed and eng.Ragab 
 Abd Elgwad, revised by eng. Abd Elazez Shalaby accepted by eng. Mahmoud 
 Badawy, Electrical Maintenance and Protection Manager, and approved by eng. 
 Ahmed Moussa Executive Operation and Maintenance Manager, revised by quality 
 control head sector eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The generator must be isolated and work permit required.
Switch off DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing any card from the 
 relay module.
Tools and Equipment
Test set MANTA
Multi - meter
Test leads
Test set MANTA
Multi - meter
Test leads
Work to be Carried Out
Pick up current
Function test
To Get pick up current
Connect the circuit as shown in figure
Short stud 7 for DC continuity
This relay is induction disk type so it will not work if we inject at one 
 phase so we must inject at 2 or 3 phases as shown in figure and since the 
 function of the relay doesnt depend on direction of current so if we changed 
 5&6 point for example the result is the same.
Connect the manta current terminals at phase 6&2 
 AND short points 5&3
Start increasing current from zero until pick up
Repeat the previous for the other phases as 
 follow:
Connect the manta current terminals at phase 8&2 
 AND short points 9&3
Connect the manta current terminals at phase 8&5 
 AND short points 9&6
